rule: The library ships an ordered evaluation procedure in which every evaluated point uses only earlier data (walk-forward or expanding splitter, progressive or prequential validation, online or sequential test, or reference-then-analysis chunking on a timestamp column), and the smoke ran it. Accepting a caller-built fold iterable does not count.

Purge or embargo by label end time (not by row count) shipped by the library, run on the challenge or a constructed case and checked by an independent overlap checker with zero overlapping training rows.
Pending or unmatured labels are represented as such (censoring, delayed label release, label-free estimation, or exclusion by maturity) and never scored or trained as negatives, shown in the smoke.
Feature availability enforcement: a library mechanism refused, dropped or nulled a feature value whose availability time is after the decision (the S1 trap or a hand-built probe), shown in the smoke.
A library leakage or chronology heuristic raised a flag in the smoke (target-proxy feature, train and test time overlap).
A library-provided past-only computation mode (backward windows, left or streaming profile, filtered state) verified by a truncation-invariance or past-only recomputation test with zero difference.
Replay discipline record: runs or artifacts carry a training cutoff, creation time, data fingerprint, or first-known (revision) timestamps that a replay check can read, shown in the smoke.
The library itself outputs per-row probabilities for a binary event (classifier, survival-to-horizon or calibrator output), finite, in [0,1] and of the right shape in S2.
A censor-aware time-to-event model (survival or competing risks) was fitted with censored rows kept as censored in the smoke.
A covariate-conditional competing-risk output that matches the T1 barrier race (target first versus invalidation first versus censored), shown in the smoke.
Continuous, quantile or volatility outputs for a continuous target produced in the smoke (code presence alone does not count).
Multi-entity generalization: a group-disjoint split by exact mint, or a model fitted across many short entity series, shown in the smoke.
The library computes a proper score (Brier, log loss, or a censor-aware Brier) used or checked in the smoke.
Post-hoc probability recalibration that can be fitted on a later window than the model (prefit or manual mode), run in the smoke with no definition error found.
Intervals, prediction sets or bootstrap intervals whose coverage was measured in the smoke (empirical or Monte Carlo).
A built-in no-decision output (empty or two-label set, refusal to return a threshold, explicit p-value floor) shown in the smoke.
Transparent uncertainty diagnostics beyond C3: reliability with counts or bands, calibration tests, standard errors, interval width or calibration checks, shown in the smoke.

Native missing-value handling in the core path: NaN covariates accepted with a defined, visible treatment (own bin, infinite distance, declared nullability, native split) and finite results, shown in S3. Silent garbage, silent row loss or a refusal earns 0.
Irregular real timestamps accepted without a fixed frequency (as-of joins, time-based purge, delayed labels on irregular times), shown in the smoke.
Feature extraction from price or volume paths (windows, change points, motifs, regime states, summaries) produced usable output in the smoke.
Cross-token or entity features: entity-keyed joins that keep same-symbol mints apart, or cross-series analog search, shown in the smoke.
Typed event or feature records produced or validated (typed feature views, schema-checked tables, typed action records), shown in the smoke.
A per-row weight or cost or utility hook in fit or evaluation (sample weights, cost matrix, custom objective) present at the pin.
Decision-threshold selection with a statistical guarantee or an explicit cost matrix, exercised in the smoke.
A guard against false confidence from selection (SPA, MCS, Reality Check, PBO, multiple-testing correction, FDR-controlled selection) exercised in the smoke.
A machine-readable alarm or failure status that a downstream gate can use to degrade or abstain (drift alarm, test status, check severity, schema failure), raised in the smoke.
A subset of the repository's own tests ran and passed (exit 0, or failures only from documented missing optional test dependencies, test data, network or keys).
The test subset that ran covers the reviewed role path, and no test was found to encode a defect.
Maintenance: a commit on or after 2026-04-24 (six months before review) and a release or tag on or after 2025-04-24 (18 months).
Declared dependencies are complete for the runtime path reviewed (no undeclared runtime import found, install as declared imports).
No silent wrong-output defect found in the role path (silent NaN, wrong math, swallowed exceptions, wrong metadata, vanishing rows).
Runs on Python 3.13 (the lab runtime), shown in the smoke.
Works with pandas 3.x and numpy 2.x without overrides or downgrades (or needs neither).
Usable as an in-process library API without a server, daemon, subprocess or LLM endpoint.
Filling its role does not require a parallel subsystem the lab plans to build itself (PLANNED_SEAMS: as-of view, label evaluator, model registry, forecast store) or a separate service store.
Install footprint under 500 MB and no GPU, browser or proprietary binaries pulled by default.
Same inputs and seed gave identical outputs across two runs, two calls or two code paths, shown in the smoke.
Save and reload gave identical outputs (bit-identical), shown in the smoke.
A persistence format for fitted state or outputs that does not execute code on load (native text, JSON, YAML safe_load, skops, npz, SQLite) was used in the smoke.
The library produced a run or audit record (run registry entry, data fingerprint, split audit, checkpoint of parameters and losses, per-run config and outputs) in the smoke.
Artifacts carry the producing library version, or a schema that detects a mismatch on load, shown in the smoke.
The role path ran with no network at import, fit and predict (guard, unshare -n or strace), with default settings or a documented local switch.
Some configuration of the role path fits the challenge-size problem in under 60 s and infers in under 100 ms per row, measured.
Peak memory under 1 GB in the smoke and no paid service (LLM, memory cloud, licensed weights) needed for the role.
A released wheel usable on Python 3.13 exists for Windows or is pure Python (PyPI file list).
Root license at the pin is permissive (MIT, BSD, Apache-2.0, NCSA). Weak copyleft would earn 1; strong copyleft (GPL, AGPL) earns 0.
The default install route carries no restrictive vendored, transitive, model-weight or data-rights terms and no unknown-rights data.
No telemetry or phone-home anywhere in the package by default (a working off switch does not earn the point).
The recommended install route was inspected and runs no install-time network or destructive script and ships what the source tree contains.
No API key, token or secret is needed for the role and no network service is exposed by default.
